terms.definition: The martial world of wandering fighters, outside conventional law.
The community of martial artists and the world of sects and rivalries they inhabit.
The famed Shaolin Monastery and its Buddhist martial tradition.
The Wudang Sect, a Taoist school famed for its internal arts.
The Emei Sect based on Mount Emei, often portrayed as a school led by women.
The vast fraternity of beggars, famed for its dog-beating staff arts.
